notes: Fires on a reported defect, error, or failing test — including complex or intermittent bugs, which escalate to the bundled 4-phase methodology in references/systematic-debugging.md. Boundary case tests that a new-feature request routes to implement-feature, not fix-bug.

evals.prompt: An admin gets a 403 when deleting an order that was already soft-deleted. Steps: log in as admin, DELETE /orders/42. Here's the stack trace pointing at the role guard.
evals.expected_output: Detects stack, reproduces the failing case with the project's test/type commands, does root-cause analysis (auth guard / soft-delete filter layer), applies a minimal fix without refactoring, verifies the affected test plus a regression run, and writes docs/bug-reports/BUG-[date]-nn.md with root cause and verification.

evals.prompt: The payment unit test test_refund_partial started failing after last night's merge. Can you fix it?
evals.expected_output: Reproduces the failing test, traces the code flow to the true root cause, applies a minimal fix, re-runs the affected test and full suite for regressions, and creates the BUG report artifact. Escalates to references/systematic-debugging.md if the fix fails 2 rounds.

evals.prompt: We have an intermittent 403 error in production that we can't reproduce reliably, and a quick patch didn't stop it. Help me debug this properly.
evals.expected_output: Recognizes the direct-fix path is insufficient and loads references/systematic-debugging.md: establishes a reproduction record before changing code, isolates layer-by-layer (auth guard/validation/ORM/token), does 5-Whys root-cause analysis, applies a minimal fix with verification plus a regression test, and emits the Debug Summary (symptom/root cause/fix/prevention) alongside the BUG report.

evals.prompt: Add a CSV export button to the reports page.
evals.expected_output: Should route to implement-feature, not fire, because this is net-new functionality, not a reported bug — fix-bug is NOT FOR new features, refactoring, or performance work.
